src/domain and src/application have no Remix/Electron/Playwright imports.

electron-builder and portable packaging copy/include the new adapter/domain paths.

Packaged/AppImage cold Present first-open hydrate is reliable (not flaky stuck on SSR Loading).
On Program works on packaged Electron after Present hydrate is reliable.
Residual AppImage risk + Jack checklist documented (include 9f124e1 baseline); draft PR #21 not marked ready or merged.
